title: The Boy Who Lost His Temper: Cooling Down the Volcano!

lines.text: Have you ever felt so angry your cheeks burned like fiery red lava?
lines.caps: Have you ever felt so *ANGRY | your cheeks burned like *FIERY | red *LAVA?

lines.text: Leo lost his favorite blue toy car and felt an explosive volcano rumble inside!
lines.caps: Leo lost his favorite *CAR | and felt an explosive *VOLCANO | rumble *INSIDE!

lines.text: He wanted to stomp, scream, and throw his pillow across the bedroom!
lines.caps: He wanted to *STOMP, | scream, and *THROW | his pillow *ACROSS the room!

lines.text: Then Rhymo whispered, When the volcano bubbles, freeze and breathe!
lines.caps: Then Rhymo *WHISPERED, | When the volcano bubbles, | *FREEZE and *BREATHE!

lines.text: Inhale through your nose like smelling sweet roses for four slow seconds!
lines.caps: *INHALE through your nose | like smelling sweet *ROSES | for four slow *SECONDS!

lines.text: Blow out gently through your lips like blowing out birthday candles!
lines.caps: *BLOW out gently | through your lips like *BLOWING | birthday *CANDLES!

lines.text: One, two, three! The fiery red heat vanished into gentle cool air!
lines.caps: One, two, *THREE! | The fiery red heat *VANISHED | into cool *AIR!

lines.text: You are the boss of your feelings, not the fiery volcano!
lines.caps: You are the *BOSS | of your feelings, *NOT | the fiery *VOLCANO!

lines.text: Stay calm, cool, and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily stories!
lines.caps: Stay *CALM, cool, | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *STORIES!
